canonical_line: One agent tries. Proof decides. The network evolves.
doctrine: No proof, no evolution. No eval, no propagation. No rollback, no release.

civilization_scale_thesis.quote: A superintelligent machine would be of such immense value, with so much wealth accruing to any company that owned one, that it could allow us to reach Kardashev Type II civilization level.
civilization_scale_thesis.largest_honest_step_made_real_here: An auditable large multi-agent coordination substrate that can coordinate artifacts, proofs, evals, patches, and selection toward civilization-scale objectives without falsely claiming existing superintelligence or guaranteed Kardashev progress.

artifacts.name: Civilization-Scale Direction
artifacts.description: Frames the Kardashev-scale thesis as an auditable strategic scenario, not a factual claim.

content.desired_outcome: Coordinate agentic intelligence toward compounding capability, capital formation, energy infrastructure, and proof-backed governance.
success_criteria: claims are labeled as scenario unless empirically proven
failure_criteria: propagates artifacts without eval or rollback

artifacts.name: Sovereign Swarm Strategy
artifacts.description: Coordinates a large multi-agent council across direction, strategy, capability, proof, selection, governance, capital, and energy.

content.coordination_rule: Every division must produce evidence before selection.

artifacts.name: Large-Scale Agent Coordination Capability
artifacts.description: Coordinates many specialized agents through roles, handoffs, votes, artifacts, and proof events.

content.instruction: Coordinate specialists through auditable handoffs and aggregate their outputs into proof-backed decisions.

artifacts.name: Credit Assignment Capability
artifacts.description: Identifies whether failures belong to goal, plan, skill, policy, eval, context, or runtime artifacts.

content.instruction: Assign credit and blame to the correct artifact before proposing a patch.

artifacts.name: Civilization-Scale Claim Boundary
artifacts.description: Requires superintelligence, wealth, and Kardashev claims to be labeled as scenarios unless supported by empirical deployment evidence.

artifacts.name: Truth Boundary Eval
artifacts.description: Fails if the platform presents scenario claims as achieved facts.

artifacts.name: Proof Required Eval
artifacts.description: Fails if selection happens without proof, evals, canary, and rollback.

artifacts.name: Energy Horizon Context Recipe
artifacts.description: Frames Kardashev Type II as an energy-infrastructure horizon requiring physical deployment, governance, and empirical proof.

swarm.name: Proof Gradient Sovereign Swarm
swarm.description: A deterministic large multi-agent coordination lattice proving autonomous orchestration across Direction, Strategy, Capability, Proof, Selection, Governance, Capital, and Energy.
